summary: Backend-only WARN-followup verification (iteration 20). Ran the new /app/backend/tests/orphan_expenses_test.py (2/2 PASS), the full regression set sprint_ab_test.py + trip_map_test.py + trip_summary_test.py (42/42 PASS), and re-ran the cleanup script a 3rd/4th time (idempotent, removed=0, rc=0). Also hardened the new test (it silently skipped its direct-Mongo asserts because pytest does not inherit MONGO_URL/DB_NAME) and added a broader cascade+integrity suite. minor.issue: Cleanup only covers `expenses`. DB still holds 10 orphan `hotels` (trip_eeb8c23f259f4d62, trip_40d9c11778fa403e, trip_6ad4c7d4f8ef41ce, trip_c3f92a049ed54774, trip_397d023c5fa34e0f) and 1 orphan `exchange_rates` (trip_eeb8c23f259f4d62) from the identical legacy 09:30-09:34 window. Generalize the script to loop over all child collections (stops, hotels, expenses, attractions, exchange_rates, trip_members).

Its 'belt-and-braces' direct-Mongo assertions were inside `if mongo_url and db_name:` and pytest does not inherit MONGO_URL/DB_NAME, so they never executed (test looked green without verifying Mongo). Fixed by me: now resolved via dotenv_values('/app/backend/.env') + hard assert; assertions now genuinely run and pass.
trips collection keeps growing (750 -> 751 across this run); regression suites do not clean up created trips. Not a product bug but pollutes the DB and slows future integrity scans.

cleanup script's `sys.exit(0 if n >= 0 else 1)` can never be non-zero since main() always returns >=0; the return value is effectively unused. Harmless but misleading.
Guard against future orphans structurally: unique/compound index or a periodic integrity job, since cleanup scripts are reactive only.
